target_customer: Go to market teams (marketing, sales, product) at startups and software companies
problem: Producing polished product launch, demo and explainer videos takes agencies weeks and costs a lot.
product_category: AI video creation for GTM teams

founders.name: Jasper Story
prior_employers: several early stage startups as developer, designer and PM

founders.name: Nicole Atack
founders.background_notes: YC launch post describes her as a former quant and particle physicist.

competitors.name: Loom
competitors.what: Quick screen and camera recording shared by link
competitors.traction_then: Widely used default for async video

technical_complexity.rationale: Quality video generation and editing pipelines on top of third party models and rendering is standard engineering with some hard media parts.

defensibility.rationale: Brand templates and team workflows add some stickiness, but video tools are numerous and model providers improve fast.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; the company repositioned in 2026 as a video product for agentic GTM teams.

market_need_then: Companies were adopting AI video for sales and marketing content in 2024; a review notes Synthesia and HeyGen own avatar videos while Yarn narrowed to product and sales videos.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and punchy: Lights. Camera. Traction.

branding.community_and_virality: Customer logos (Clay, Faire, Front) and a Clay cofounder quote on the site; no other community evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: A friendly short name, but it clashes with the Yarn package manager, a 2015 video clip app and a chat fiction app, which hurts search.

pivots.from: AI video maker for product and sales videos
pivots.to: Video product for agentic GTM teams
pivots.why: Repositioning to agent driven workflows (MCP, generative demos) per the company site; date from aggregator profile.

outcome_analysis: Yarn is an active Winter 2024 company with named backers and customers like Clay and Faire. The site claims 80,000 videos produced. Funding amounts are not verified and it repositioned toward agentic GTM use, so outcome is unresolved and depends on competing with Loom, Arcade and avatar tools.
notes: Amounts conflict across aggregators: about $500K (CB Insights, VCBacked, StartupIntros) versus $5M (Clera); unverified, so the round has a null amount. The company site confirms backers YC, General Catalyst and Race Capital; other lists add Leonis Capital and Pioneer Fund. Stage labeled other because only aggregators call it seed or pre-seed. Competitor source is a competitor's marketing page. Do not confuse with the 2015 video clip app or the chat fiction app named Yarn.
